# Comprehensive Review Gate Checklist: Public Access to OpenAPI and Swagger UI Endpoints

**Purpose**: Validate specification and contract quality, security boundaries, OpenAPI schema declarations, and documentation fidelity before task breakdown and implementation  
**Created**: 2026-09-13  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | **Plan**: [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Security & Access Boundary Requirements

- [x] CHK001 - Are the exact URI patterns permitted without authentication comprehensively enumerated without wildcards that risk exposing business endpoints? [Security, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 - Are negative access requirements explicitly defined for all actuator endpoints (`/actuator/**`) on domain services? [Security, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 - Are CSRF protection requirements unambiguously specified for stateless REST and documentation endpoints? [Security, Contract §1]
- [x] CHK004 - Are OAuth2 JWT Bearer token validation requirements explicitly asserted for all non-documentation endpoints? [Security, Spec §FR-003, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK005 - Is the boundary between public documentation access and protected domain API execution clearly delineated? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2]
- [x] CHK006 - Are session management policies explicitly required to remain stateless across all secured services? [Consistency, Data Model §2]

---

## 2. OpenAPI & Swagger UI Contract Quality

- [x] CHK007 - Is the OpenAPI HTTP Bearer JWT security scheme formally defined with specific attribute names (`bearerAuth`, `bearerFormat: JWT`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK008 - Are requirements specified for exposing the global "Authorize" button in Swagger UI across all secured domain services? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the OpenAPI definition requirement decoupled from application bootstrap entrypoint classes to maintain clean separation of concerns? [Consistency, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK010 - Are the required OpenAPI metadata attributes (title, version, description) specified for each domain service? [Clarity, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK011 - Does the specification clarify whether services without security components (e.g., analytics service) declare or omit the security scheme? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §1]

---

## 3. Scope Boundaries & Architectural Constraints

- [x] CHK012 - Is gateway documentation routing explicitly identified as out-of-scope to preserve service autonomy? [Scope, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 - Are direct microservice port endpoints explicitly identified as the canonical access points for Swagger UI inspection? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK014 - Does the specification forbid modifying existing public routes in the API Gateway configuration? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK015 - Are dedicated configuration class package naming conventions (`nl.invokedynamic.demo.<service>.config`) consistently mandated? [Traceability, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Project Structure]

---

## 4. Edge Cases & Exception Handling

- [x] CHK016 - Are browser redirect requirements from `/swagger-ui.html` to `/swagger-ui/index.html` explicitly accounted for in the permitted path list? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 - Are requirements specified for static web assets (CSS, JS, webjars, favicons) loaded asynchronously by Swagger UI? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK018 - Are error responses for unauthenticated requests on protected endpoints quantified as HTTP 401 Unauthorized with standard challenge headers? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, Contract §1]

---

## 5. Documentation & Operational Guidance

- [x] CHK019 - Does the specification require updating README documentation to distinguish between viewing schemas and executing secured operations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK020 - Are instructions for obtaining a Keycloak Bearer token specified as an explicit prerequisite for testing secured operations in Swagger UI? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the walkthrough in the README consistent with the live port mappings and direct inspection flow? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, Quickstart §Scenario B]

---

## 6. Testability & Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK022 - Can success criterion SC-001 (100% of services responding with HTTP 200 on documentation paths) be objectively verified via automated tests? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Quickstart §Scenario B]
- [x] CHK023 - Can success criterion SC-002 (zero security regressions / HTTP 401 on protected endpoints) be objectively verified without manual browser interaction? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Quickstart §Scenario C]
- [x] CHK024 - Are automated security test requirements defined for each secured microservice using Spring Boot Test slices? [Coverage, Plan §Implementation Strategy, Quickstart §Scenario A]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- All items in this checklist evaluate requirements completeness, consistency, clarity, and coverage (not implementation status)
